integrity_contract: Each environment image is its task's environment/Dockerfile built once, on 2026-08-17, from a mutable base tag with a network installer, so rebuilding yields a different image. The image is identified by image_id, the manifest digest in its archive's OCI index, and by the archive's SHA-256; a host without the image loads the archive and never rebuilds. The source extractor is pinned so every host restores working trees with the same tool, and each restored tree is proved against its environment image.
